trials.label: 2% Gyroid; waist down; rejected roof tradeoff

reason: Waist-down used the least material of the tested 3% orientations. 2% saved about 19g and21min but gave much longer roof spans at the leg seam caps. Retain3% for these mating faces.
roof_check_scope: Sampled generated toolpaths, not a physical bridging test. Gyroid phase means higher density does not shorten every internal bridge.
error_diagnosis: Original Infill failed error was not reproduced in the available engine. Replacement is one closed manifold solid with Gyroid instead of Lightning.
